title: Family identification with este/esta
explanation: Use este with masculine nouns and esta with feminine nouns in controlled family sentences. Do not teach the full demonstrative system here; only produce useful sentences such as Este es mi padre and Esta es mi madre.

title: Family names with se llama
explanation: Use se llama to state another person's name. In this module it combines with family words: Mi hermana se llama Marta.

title: Tengo, tienes, tiene for family
explanation: Use tengo to speak about yourself, tienes to ask another person, and tiene to speak about another person. Keep the pattern bounded to family facts.

title: Rooms with este/esta
explanation: Use este/esta with rooms in fixed identification sentences. The focus is recognizing and naming rooms, not a complete gender lesson.

title: Location with estar at home
explanation: Use está to locate a known person or object. The known item comes first, then está en plus the room or place.
examples: La mesa está en la cocina.
Mi madre está en el salón.
La cama está en el dormitorio.

title: Hay versus está at home
explanation: Use hay to say that something exists in a place. Use está to locate a specific known thing or person.
examples: Hay una mesa en la cocina.
La mesa está en la cocina.
Hay una cama en el dormitorio.

title: Quién and dónde questions
explanation: Use quién to ask who a person is. Use dónde to ask where a person, room, or object is.
